parameters.query:
-- Every user's items stuck in "watching", with their email address.
-- Read-only: this SELECT cannot alter application data.
SELECT u.email,
       w.title,
       w.platform,
       (CURRENT_DATE - w.updated_at::date) AS days_idle,
       COALESCE(w.poster_url, mp.url)      AS poster
FROM watchlist w
JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id
LEFT JOIN media_primary_poster mp ON mp.media_id = w.media_id
WHERE w.status = 'watching'
  AND w.updated_at < now() - interval '14 days'
  -- Guard: this database holds seed/QA accounts. @example.com is IANA-reserved
  -- and hard-bounces, which damages sender reputation. Drop these two lines once
  -- the test users are gone.
  AND u.email NOT LIKE '%@example.com'
  AND u.email NOT LIKE '%.local'
ORDER BY u.email, w.updated_at;
